استوفين (form X)
# اِسْتَوْفَيْنَ (istawfayna) /is.taw.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْفَى (istawfā)
# اُسْتُوفِينَ (ustūfīna) /us.tuː.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْفَى (istawfā)
# اِسْتَوْفِينَ (istawfīna) /is.taw.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْفَى (istawfā)
